name: 50003 · Adel, IA
findings: ZIP 50003 (Adel) has 50 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (22%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 8 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (12% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 50003 (Adel) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 6 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 46% of all organizations here have no identified type.
